category_title: Social fourth-grade student with learning disabilities who frequently seeks teacher assistance
minimal_context: Julia is sitting at the computer in her writing class, tasked with independently revising her draft to add vivid descriptions and details.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Julia, please open your draft on the computer. I want you to revise your work independently by adding some actions, feelings, and precise nouns to make the description better.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises hand immediately) I don't know what to do. I can't get started on this by myself.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read what you have so far and try to add some details where you can.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But I feel really challenged by this writing. I don't know how to spell the new words, and my sentences are all messed up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying. Just do your best to organize your thoughts on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Complaining) I can't organize it! I struggle with the planning and the grammar, and I need you to come over here and help me fix the sentence structure!

dialogue_combined:

task.content: revise their work by adding actions, feelings, similes, metaphors, and using active verbs and precise nouns to engage the reader with vivid description
task.learning_goal: revise their writing based on feedback

context.environment: typical writing class and In front of the computer
context.materials: funny mask or wig, ingredients for a 'writer's soup' (broth, carrots, and beans), computer applications, iMovie, Garage Band, visual materials
context.social_setting: collaborating with others about her writing

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked to revise work or add details independently.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: struggled with planning, organization, sentence structure, grammar, and spelling, complaining
related_quotes: struggled with planning, organization, sentence structure, grammar, and spelling

behavior_patterns.condition: When faced with revising or expanding her writing independently.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: her hand was often the first one to go up for help
related_quotes: her hand was often the first one to go up for help
